messages:
maya: Quick async OKR spot check for Q2 milestones — please react or reply with updates by EOD.
- Shipped: Dedicated autoscale policy UI (owner: jon) ✅
- Shipped: model-variant fallback routing (owner: kyle) ✅
- Slipped: Private deployment VPC onboarding (owner: ashley) — blocked on infra VPN certs
- At-risk: Optimize batching heuristics rollout (owner: sam) — needs eval infra

Asks:
1) Jon: confirm any rollout followups after deploy and whether we can close the milestone 🎯
2) Kyle: any perf regressions from fallback rollout to note? any follow-up tasks?
3) Ashley: ETA on the VPN certs or mitigation plan (can we scope a narrower MVP?)
4) Sam: status on eval infra quota — is it enough to finish the regression tests?

Also tagging eng-oncall for potential fallout: @kyle @jon

jon: Autoscale UI deployed last night, telemetry looks stable. A small follow-up to remove a debug flag, will send a PR today. We can close milestone after that. :thumbsup:

kyle: Fallback rollout went to 50% traffic, latency unchanged, small uptick in tail p95 for long-context requests (+12ms). Filing ticket to look at kernel selection for long seqs: https://redwood/issues/4567

ashley: VPN certs still blocked by infra approval queue. ETA from infra team is ~3 business days. Short-term mitigation: we can provide a fenced subnet + cs-managed tunnel for a pilot if product agrees. Need decision on scope by tomorrow.

sam: Eval infra — quota bumped + test queue cleared this morning. We still need a small dataset from product (prompt set + pass/fail criteria). I can run the regression suite once we get that.

deploy-bot: deploy #prod-release/v2.3.1 succeeded — 2026-03-15 03:12 UTC (sha: a1b2c3d)

maya: Thanks all. Quick decisions:
- Jon: we mark Dedicated autoscale UI as shipped once your PR merges; please add the release tag in the PR description.
- Kyle: open a follow-up spike for the long-context p95 and assign to eng-runtime; add expected outcome and timeframe.
- Ashley: propose the pilot fenced-subnet plan in a short doc (1-2 bullets) and post here — product can sign off asap.
- Sam: I'll drop the prompt set by EOD.

If you agree, react with :white_check_mark: and owners, please paste a one-line ETA. If blocked, paste :warning: with the blocker.

kyle: ✅ ETA for spike ticket: 2 weeks (start mon)

jon: ✅ PR link will be posted in #eng-releases within 2 hours.

ashley: :warning: infra approval still blocking, pilot doc incoming in 3h

sam: ✅ prompt set uploaded to the eval bucket (s3://redwood-evals/q2/batching) — you should have access.

maya: Great — closing the loop. I'll compile these into the OKR tracker and ping stakeholders tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone.
